title: core.party.deleted v1
description: Emitted when a party is soft-deleted (GDPR/DPDP right-to-deletion). Hard deletion follows after the grace period via a separate process; this event is the trigger for downstream PII scrubs.

retention_class_override.description: If non-null, overrides default retention; e.g. finance.invoices keep records 7 years even after party delete.
